items.title: Anthropic essentially bans OpenClaw from Claude by making subscribers pay extra
items.summary: Claude subscriptions will no longer cover third-party access from tools like OpenClaw starting Saturday, April 4th. This marks a significant shift in Anthropic's API access policy.

items.title: Meta pauses work with Mercor after data breach puts AI industry secrets at risk
items.summary: A company that makes AI training data, Mercor, has been hit by a security breach. Meta has paused work with Mercor while OpenAI is investigating the incident.

items.title: Elon Musk demands banks and advisers buy Grok subscriptions for SpaceX IPO access
items.summary: The New York Times reports that Musk is requiring banks, law firms, auditors and other advisers working on the SpaceX IPO to buy subscriptions to his Grok AI platform.

items.title: US employers added a surprisingly strong 178,000 jobs last month, rebounding from a weak February
items.summary: American employers added 178,000 new jobs in March, rebounding from a dismal February. The unemployment rate dipped to 4.3%, beating market expectations.

items.title: Trump unveils 100% tariff on some patented drugs on 'Liberation Day' anniversary
items.summary: President Trump announced sweeping 100% tariffs on certain patented pharmaceutical drugs, marking the anniversary of his 'Liberation Day' tariff announcement.

items.title: Stocks recover from early losses and close with a weekly gain; US oil tops $110 a barrel
items.summary: US stocks rebounded to close the week with gains despite Iran war-driven volatility. Oil prices surged past $110 a barrel as the conflict continues to rattle energy markets.

items.title: 2 US aircraft shot down as war in Iran escalates; at least 1 crew member is missing
items.summary: Two U.S. military planes were shot down in separate incidents on Friday, escalating tensions in the ongoing Iran conflict. One fighter jet was downed inside Iran, marking the first US aircraft lost to enemy fire in over 20 years.

items.title: UK gathers more than 40 countries to press Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Britain convened a coalition of over 40 nations to demand Iran reopen the Strait of Hormuz, as the closure continues to strangle global oil exports and cause economic shockwaves worldwide.

items.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine kill 8 as Kyiv holds door open for Easter truce
items.summary: Russia launched fresh aerial attacks on Ukraine killing at least 8 people, even as Ukraine signaled openness to a potential Easter ceasefire. A prisoner exchange is also being planned for the holiday.
